name: NOAA HYSPLIT-compatible meteorological data archives
frequency: At present, the following five datasets are updated every day or every week: - HRRR 3 km archive (Jun 2019 - present) - daily - NAMS Hybrid sigma-pressure archive (2010 - present) - daily - NAM 12 km archive (May 2007 - present) - daily - GDAS one-degree archive (Dec 2004 - present) - weekly - GFS quarter-degree archive (Jun 2019 - present) - daily The following two datasets are updated monthly: - NCEP/NCAR reanalysis archive (1948 - present) - monthly, typically around the 5th of the following month. - Weather research and forecasting model 27 km archive (1980 - present) - monthly, typically with a delay of two to three months. The following datasets are no longer updated: - HRRR 3 km version 1 archive (Jun 2015 - Jul 2019) - frozen - GDAS half-degree archive (Sep 2007 - Jun 2019) - frozen - FNL archive (1997 - 2006) - frozen - NGM archive (Jan 1991 - Apr 1997) - frozen - NAM data assimilation system archive (2004 - 2018) - frozen - NAM(Eta) data assimilation system archive (1997 - 2004) - frozen - NARR archive (1979 - 2019) - frozen

name: East Coast Community Ocean Forecast System (ECCOFS)
frequency: An ECCOFS 4D-Var analysis is conducted every 24 hours, assimilating observations aggregated for the preceding 3 days, and this provides the basis of a new 5-day ocean forecast. Outputs saved in this data archive are daily average sea level, and ocean temperature, salinity and velocity on the full ROMS curvilinear, terrain-following coordinate grid.

These files can be found under the subdirectories of hfsa_retro and hfsb_retro. Additional forecast files from the 2022 hurricane season can be made available upon user request.

frequency: The update frequencies of the WAM-IPE dataset range from 10 minutes to 6 hours depending on the CONOPS.

name: NOAA Global Forecast System (GFS) netCDF Formatted Data
frequency: Out of the four operational GFS forecast cycles per day (at 00Z, 06Z, 12Z and 18Z) this particular netCDF dataset is updated daily (/yyyymmdd) for the 12Z cycle and includes hourly output out to 24 hours for both 2D (gfs.t12z.sfcf$0hh.nc) and 3D variables (gfs.t12z.atmf$0hh.nc). The data is uploaded daily at ~ 1800 UTC. The climatological GLDSs (including vegetative canopy data variables) are updated on an as-needed basis when new sources, methods, and advancements become available.
